sources.quote: 8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
4. Finish: anodise type II, thickness 10 to 15 micrometres, black, per specification SPEC-FIN-12.
Switch the BR-220 finish from type II anodise to chromate conversion coat.

findings.why: BR-220 is on a Stellantis program (STL-Torino-27, Annex A). Drawing Rev C, the revision in force, specifies the finish as anodise type II. Changing it to a chromate conversion coat changes a drawing requirement. CSR 8.3.6.1 requires written Stellantis approval before the change is implemented. No approval from Stellantis appears in the documents.
